# Rohan Pandey

> {{ site.description }}

- Role: PhD student (fourth year), Computer Science, University of Massachusetts Amherst
- Lab: Bio-NLP Lab (https://bio-nlp.org/), advised by Prof. Hong Yu
- Previously: McKinsey & Company (product owner and engineer on AI-powered spend analytics: Source AI, Spendscape); research at HITI Lab, Emory University and TavLab, IIITD
- Education: B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Shiv Nadar University (High Distinction)
- Email: rohanpandey@umass.edu
- Website: {{ site.url }}/
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Xdlmg9IAAAAJ
- GitHub: https://github.com/rohanpandey
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/therohanpandey/

## Research interests

- AI for healthcare: using AI to tackle public-health challenges (homelessness, opioid overdose) and making AI work in real-world healthcare settings, from messy electronic health records (EHRs) to clinical workflows.
- Science of AI: understanding what makes AI systems work or fail, and how to make them better.
- AI for science: building tools that help scientists do better science, and understanding what widespread AI use means for the practice, validity, and communication of science.
